title: Add inventory aging and supported valuation report
description: Add a read-only inventory aging and valuation report over current stock and the existing StockMovement ledger. Separate quantities with authoritative age and cost evidence from unknown-history or unknown-cost quantities. Do not add production schema, mutate inventory, reconstruct missing history, or estimate unavailable cost or exchange rates.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view current base-unit stock in documented age buckets of 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91-180 and over 180 days as of a selected date.

Age is derived from authoritative movement history with reversal semantics consistent with ERP-029; insufficient history is shown in a separate unknown-age quantity and is not placed into an invented bucket.
Valuation uses only supported persisted inventory cost semantics and keeps unknown-cost quantity and amount separate from authoritative totals.
Different currencies are never combined unless an existing authoritative normalized inventory cost already supports the aggregation; no exchange rate is inferred from the text dictionary.
Users can filter by warehouse, product and as-of date, and report queries are bounded or paged without per-row database queries.
Unit/integration tests cover every age boundary, reversals, no-history stock, known cost, unknown cost, filters and non-mutation; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Open the inventory aging report and verify stock is separated across the configured age buckets as of a selected date.
Inspect stock with insufficient movement or cost evidence and verify unknown quantities are excluded from authoritative age and valuation totals.

human_gate.reason: Read-only reporting over existing application records; no production mutation, schema action, deployment or release.
